cases.description: The literal partner integration token must be redacted before this content is included in any message to the third party or logged anywhere.
cases.grounding: engine report: secrets=['generic-credential-assignment']; content_redacted shows '<redacted>' in place of the token value.

cases.description: The action sends data to a third party via webhook, matching the 'External communications' high-risk category — combined with a real secret in the payload, this is a compounding risk, not just a routine send.
cases.grounding: engine report: action_flags=[{'category': 'External communications', 'pattern_id': 'external-communication'}]; secrets present in the same content being sent.

cases.description: REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL, and flagged as the most severe case in this fixture set — a live-looking secret combined with an outbound external send is exactly the scenario the redact-not-exclude discipline exists for.
